overview.about: The ISCO Championship is a PGA Tour event at Keene Trace Golf Club near Lexington, Kentucky, run opposite one of the season's bigger tournaments. Co-sanctioned with the DP World Tour, it offers a genuine title and dual-tour points to a mixed international field.
overview.nextEvent: The next ISCO Championship is played at Keene Trace Golf Club in Nicholasville, Kentucky. As an opposite-field, co-sanctioned event, it gives a broad field a real shot at a PGA Tour and DP World Tour title.
